propositions: autodeploy.sh recreates the review-bot container mid-review without draining in-flight work, causing reviews to be killed before they vote and the LLM-Review gate to live-lock
the reconciler retry path (reconcile_loop awaiting review_and_vote inline) is unprotected by the app's shutdown drain, making it the vector for repeated interruption during landing bursts

landing bursts produce deploys faster than reviews complete (gaps as short as 4 minutes vs ~10 minute reviews), causing the gate to stall while all health signals remain green and no VOTER_ERROR alarm fires
the fix defers deployment when the bot reports in-flight reviews busy, using an episode-bound timer (1800s, keyed to deferral episode not target SHA) to prevent permanent blocking
observability is added via AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED and AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT metrics with a new CloudWatch paging alarm for review interrupts, including signal-unavailable failures
